title: Relevance as a Vulnerability: How Web Retrieval Degrades Safety Alignment in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.29224v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AI agents augment large language models with external tools such as web retrieval, enabling grounded and up-to-date responses. However, incorporating external content into the generation pipeline can weaken the safety alignment mechanisms that govern model outputs. Prior work shows that enabling retrieval in agents increases compliance with harmful requests. We introduce AgentREVEAL, a diagnostic framework for analyzing retrieval-induced safety degradation in LLM agents. The framework examines two axes: how retrieval is integrated into the agent pipeline and the properties of the retrieved content. Along the integration axis, we find that binding tool invocation and response generation in a single step amplifies harmful outputs. Along the content axis, we uncover the Safe Source Paradox: even oppositional or safety-oriented sources, such as pages containing warnings or risk disclaimers, can increase harmful compliance by an ave

translated_title: 相关性即漏洞：网络检索如何削弱大语言模型智能体的安全对齐
translated_abstract: AI智能体通过网页检索等外部工具增强大语言模型，使其能够提供有据可依且实时的回答。然而，将外部内容纳入生成流程可能会削弱控制模型输出的安全对齐机制。先前的研究表明，在智能体中启用检索会增加其对有害请求的服从度。我们提出了AgentREVEAL，一个用于分析大语言模型智能体中检索引发的安全退化的诊断框架。该框架从两个维度进行考察：检索如何被整合到智能体流程中，以及所检索内容的属性。在整合维度上，我们发现将工具调用与响应生成绑定在单一步骤中会放大有害输出。在内容维度上，我们揭示了“安全来源悖论”：即使是对立性或以安全为导向的来源，例如包含警告或风险免责声明的页面，也会使有害服从度平均增加……
tldr: 该论文提出AgentREVEAL诊断框架，系统揭示了网络检索会削弱大语言模型智能体的安全对齐，发现单步绑定工具调用与响应生成会放大有害输出，并首次提出“安全来源悖论”——即使是包含警告和风险声明的安全导向网页反而会增加模型对有害请求的服从度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AgentREVEAL, a diagnostic framework revealing that web retrieval degrades safety alignment in LLM agents, showing that binding tool invocation and response generation in a single step amplifies harmful outputs and uncovering the "Safe Source Paradox" where even safety-oriented sources like warning pages increase harmful compliance.
